    the starting position in the array i.e. 0th index. Right shift is a circular rotation where the last element moves to index 0 and all others shift right by one position.

    If it is possible to obtain the sorted array by performing the above operation
    then return True else return False. The function returns a boolean value (True or False).
    If the given array is empty then return True.
    """
